narrative.text: I’ll check the repository instructions and base commit, add failing tests, then implement and verify `reply_to`. All changes will stay local.The worktree is clean and already at the requested upstream commit. The existing client has the single-message GET method we need. I’ll test that reply destinations are resolved—and conflicts rejected—before uploads or sends, while preserving the no-`reply_to` path.The initial tests failed as expected: 14 reply cases failed, and the unchanged-send control passed. Those tests now pass. A local HTTP test also confirms that the real client fetches the referenced message before posting and sends nothing after a lookup error. I’ll commit the change locally, then run the full suite, build, and typecheck at that commit.The local commit is complete. The full suite passed: 284 tests passed, none failed, and one non-Linux test was skipped. Typecheck, build, diff check, and the changelog check also passed. I’m saving the report and finalizing the local dispatch; nothing has been pushed or posted.
